answer: We formulate a mechanism requiring dynamic opportunity-cost bonds paired with subgame-perfect slashing matrices to penalize collateral dilution, forcing attackers to the ledge of bankruptcy as they attempt Sybil multiplication. By anchoring staking rewards to a verifiable delay function, the expected payoff for identity expansion becomes negative, effectively severing the vine of malicious node growth before it reaches the summit of consensus control.
